BRAWL BAR: Bugs fixed:
Fixed: Icon for creator mode characters did not display at the correct position when giving food.
Fixed: Decision factor did not apply to allies.
Fixed: Accessibility issues with Brawl Bar quizz questions.
Fixed: In creator mode, a stray enemy without correct stats would be created sometimes.

Fixed: Duplicating a character/trap would sometimes also duplicate the original one at the same position.

Fixed: In chapter 4 finale's chase, the shadow of the bike was lacking after the first death.
Fixed: You can no longer get stuck (or items appearing) at the very far right position of the room.

Fixed: Graff now has proper "_w" files for making mods.
Fixed: Generic rat was missing some animation model sprites for making a mod.
Fixed: Generic rat always was named "Rogue" instead of the custom name when making a mod based on him.
Fixed: Deleting a music in the creator would not allow to delete more after, until leaving the creator.
Fixed: Player could get softlocked if grabbed at the same time as launching a special attack.
Fixed: Player could get softlocked if something interrupted the grab.
Fixed: Some sounds could be unloaded accidentally.
Main game bugs fixed:
Using WASD in adventure mode didn't have smooth movements on obstacles like analogue stick on a controller.
The "ENTER to throw" message would sometimes stay on screen.
In coop mode, the characters available could be duplicated in the menu.
In chapter 4 finale's chase, the shadow of the bike was lacking after the first death.

This update brings all the improvements of the coming "The Brawl Bar" to the main game (in particular, action gameplay such as parry and many, many adjustments!)
This involves many code changes made during the last two years.

We've done a lot of testing but as you know, this is a complex game. In case you encounter any issue, I have made a special branch named "1.4.8" that you can revert to in the game properties => Beta (no password needed)

News and fanarts are now retrieved from my server: this means I no longer have to do small updates so often to include new ones. They're still included in the package though, so you can see them even when running offline.

Online co-op supported through Steam Remote Play Together (only one copy of the game needed): Making this update took three months and was a lot of work, I hope you enjoy it!: 1.4.0: --------------------
BIG CO-OP UPDATE!: * Up to 4 players can play through the whole adventure and drop in/drop out: * Co-op players can play as 6 different characters (to unlock)

New "controllers" menu option lists all the available and used controllers on the PC, and can reassign players.: => It's possible to do co-op with one player using keyboard/mouse and another using one controller. Of course you can also use several controllers.: => When switching on a controller, you are now required to either: * press START to use that controller for player 2 (which means player 1 has to use the keyboard/mouse): * press any other button or move the stick to use that controller for player 1 (like before)
Single player quick fights now allows to play as these 6 characters too.

Under the hood change: BIG texture management overhaul, only loading what's necessary for a room instead of keeping everything into RAM.: => Should improve RAM usage, especially on low RAM systems like Switch.: => Can improve boot time: => Might cause some "disappearing sprites" for a few frames in some locations where it's not properly handled, will be fixed progressively.

ACCESSIBILITY UPDATE
BROK is now the first full-fledged adventure game to be fully playable by blind or visually impaired players!
Fully narrated via text-to-speech and audiodescriptions.
Puzzles adapted for blindness.
Positional audio for fights, which of course can be skipped.
No online connectivity required.
No specific device required, play with keyboard or a controller.
Additional options for larger fonts and increased contrast.

To enter the accessibility menu, press SPACE (or Y on a Xbox controller) on the title screen, then follow the audio instructions.: IMPORTANT: Accessibility speeches are only available in English, so you must understand this language.
Past conversations are now spoken (for everyone)
Picking up items with keyboard now requires to press ALT (or the redefined key) to avoid picking them up by accident instead of attacking.
